mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome. I’m so glad you’re here. Have you ever found yourself wondering why life sometimes seems so unfair—why hardship can strike the very people who deserve it least? You’re not alone in that feeling. Together, in this journey, we’ll explore some of the hardest questions we face when life turns upside down. Drawing from Harold S. Kushner’s heartfelt work, When Bad Things Happen to Good People, we’ll walk alongside those who grapple with loss, and open up to the ways faith, pain, and hope all weave together during times of suffering. We’ll look at what it really means to search for meaning when the world doesn’t seem to make sense, and how the weight of grief can sometimes lead us to surprising places of understanding and resilience. There’s no promise of easy answers here, but what if, instead, we found comfort through honest questions, shared stories, and the courage to keep moving forward? Kushner’s perspective invites us to rethink old ideas about justice and faith, and shows us how, even in chaos, we might discover unexpected strength in empathy, and a deeper sense of connection. So, as we begin, let’s open ourselves to the possibility of healing and hope—together.
